brand.name: Mowgli Games
brand.tagline: Soft, round, and a little silly.

sentence.en: Mowgli Games is an independent studio making soft, playful casual games that anyone can pick up and enjoy.
sentence.ko: 모글리 게임즈는 누구나 쉽게 시작하고 즐길 수 있는, 말랑하고 장난스러운 캐주얼 게임을 만드는 인디 스튜디오입니다.

set.name: Night Peek
set.mechanism: Something friendly is peeking at you from the dark: two round, mismatched yellow eyes make the mark, a soft heavy sans speaks plainly beside them, and the palette is jungle-night green-black lit by one deep yellow.
set.expression_move: The two eyes are the only drawn thing; everything else stays quiet so they can look at you.
set.differs_by: No named competitors; against the casual-game shelf of bright multi-colour mascots, this keeps one colour on dark and lets a glance carry the character.

logo.concept: Two round eyes in the dark, one a little bigger, both glancing the same way: curious, a bit silly, never scary.

defaults_used.why: The user asked for a deep yellow key colour on dark (questionnaire A11); the flagged tone is that same yellow and its darker step, not a separate gold accent added for warmth.

rationale.claim: Dark ground with a deep yellow key colour is the user's stated preference.
Round, mismatched eyes carry 'soft, round, and a little silly' without drawing a full mascot, so the mark stays simple at 16 px.
Round forms read as soft (shape-language studies, context-bound).
